name: atlas-studio-alan-vo
workflows: Import job postings with source URL, company, title, deadline, and content snippet
Run the deterministic TF-IDF relevance scoring pipeline against a target role profile, with fetch-failure retry semantics that never conflate a failed fetch with an expired posting
Evaluate the scorer against a labeled dataset of 10 job postings with explicit IR metrics (Precision@k, MAP, NDCG)
Opt-in LLM explanation of scoring rationale, grounded in actual TF-IDF matched terms, supporting OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, Gemini, and Ollama providers
